name: katomation
description: K{Atomation} — Universal Job Application Autofill Chrome Extension (Milestone 1)

scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p dist/popup dist/options && cp manifest.json dist/ && cp -r public/. dist/ && cp src/popup/popup.html src/popup/popup.css dist/popup/ && cp src/options/options.html src/options/options.css dist/options/
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:js && npm run build:assets
scripts.test: esbuild tests/detection.test.ts tests/workdayFirstNameAutofill.test.ts tests/workdayFieldsAutofill.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=.test-dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs && node --test .test-dist/*.mjs && rm -rf .test-dist
